pages.text: Only food that can be placed as a block counts toward a banquet — a cake, for one. Other mods are supported as well: Farmer's Delight, Kaleidoscope Cookery, Youkai's Feasts, Display Delight, and Some Assembly Required.

Farmer's Delight pies and the large dishes, placed food from Display Delight, customized burgers and sandwitches, and foods served in all manner of containers in Kaleidoscope Cookery are supported.$(br2)In Youkai's Feasts, these forms of food are supported:$(li)dishes on plates, in bowls, in pots and in bamboo tubes$(li)sushi on the cuisine board$(li)food inside a steam rack
